title: Condense Current Work file details with progressive disclosure
summary: Condense the backend-authored Current Work selected-file detail into an outcome-first normal view while preserving complete technical evidence under the existing global Advanced mode.
reason: The current selected-file view renders every route reason, stage timestamp, per-track evidence record, path, and provenance field at once, making routine successful outcomes difficult to scan and causing track evidence to collapse into very tall narrow columns.
affected_areas: WebView Home Current Work selected-file detail
Canonical WebView operator and test documentation
behavior_before: Selected files show three full route cards, every stage card with complete timestamps/provenance, verbose per-track evidence in a fixed four-column table, and all output/recovery evidence in the normal view.
behavior_after: The normal view leads with a compact backend-derived outcome, decision trail, active/actionable stage summary, concise track outcomes, and useful output/recovery actions. Full route cards, canonical stage ledger, track timelines, intermediate paths, identifiers, timestamps, reason codes, and provenance remain discoverable through the existing global Advanced mode.
tests_added: Static contract coverage for outcome, route-summary, stage-summary, Advanced evidence, and responsive presentation hooks
Browser visibility coverage proving normal mode hides technical evidence and Advanced restores it
Browser coverage for concise output size, route trail, active subtitle progress, and compact Track/Source/Outcome labels
rollback_plan: Revert the packet-listed WebView markup, Run Monitor rendering, styles, tests, and documentation as one presentation unit. No backend schema, persisted state, media policy, or filesystem migration is involved.
